export const TOGGLE_ORDER = Object.keys(TOGGLES) as Toggle[]

export const isKind = (toggle: Toggle): toggle is Kind => toggle !== 'plugin'

export const KIND_ORDER = TOGGLE_ORDER.filter(isKind)

const channels = (hex: string) =>
  [1, 3, 5].map(i => Number.parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16)) as [number, number, number]

/** Blends `#RRGGBB` a toward b by t (0 is a, 1 is b). */
export const mix = (a: string, b: string, t: number) => {
  const [from, to] = [channels(a), channels(b)]
  const hex = from.map((c, i) => {
    const value = Math.round(c + (to[i]! - c) * t)
    return value.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')
  })
  return `#${hex.join('').toUpperCase()}`
}

export const BORDER_MIX = 0.2

export const HOVER_MIX = 0.1

export const STAT_TILE = { light: '#F5F6F8', dark: '#2A2C31' } as const

export const STOPPED = { fg: '#FFFFFF', bg: '#B42318' } as const

export const SPINNER = ['◐', '◓', '◑', '◒'] as const

export const SPIN_MS = 150

export const FRESH_MS = 4000

export const paletteFor = (theme: unknown): Palette => {
  const match = typeof theme === 'string' ? /^(light|dark)(-daltonized)?$/.exec(theme) : null
  return match ? (match[1] === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark') : undefined
}

export type StatusTheme = { label: string; badge?: string; glyph?: string; color?: Color }

export const STATUSES: Record<Status, StatusTheme> = {
  active: { label: 'Active' },
  ok: { label: 'OK' },
  running: { label: 'Running' },
  blocked: { label: 'Blocked', badge: 'BLOCKED', color: 'error' },
  denied: { label: 'Denied', badge: 'DENIED', color: 'error' },
  error: { label: 'Error', badge: 'ERROR', glyph: '▲', color: 'error' },
}

export const isStopped = (status: Status) => status === 'blocked' || status === 'denied'

export const isUrgent = (status: Status) => isStopped(status) || status === 'error'

  checkpoint: 'M3.5 14V2.5M3.5 3h8l-2 3 2 3h-8',
  model: 'M2.5 4.5h11M2.5 11.5h11M10 3v3M6 10v3',
  background: 'M2.5 3.5h11v9h-11zM5 7l2 1.5L5 10M8.5 10.5h2.5',

}

const ERROR_PATH = 'M8 2L14.5 13.5h-13zM8 6.5v3M8 11.6v.1'

const RING_ARC = 'M8 2.5a5.5 5.5 0 0 1 5.5 5.5'

const NEUTRAL = '#8B909A'

export const OFF_TRACK = '#C4C8D0'

const XMLNS = 'xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"'

/** Images don't inherit `currentColor`, so a theme key like `suggestion` falls back to grey. */
export const hexOr = (color: string | undefined, fallback = NEUTRAL) =>
  color !== undefined && /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(color) ? color : fallback

const strokeSvg = (body: string, color: string) =>
  `<svg ${XMLNS} viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${body}</svg>`

export const iconSvg = (toggle: Toggle, color: string) =>
  strokeSvg(`<path d="${ICONS[toggle]}"/>`, color)

export const errorSvg = (color: string) => strokeSvg(`<path d="${ERROR_PATH}"/>`, color)

export const SPIN_FRAMES = 4

export const spinnerSvg = (frame: number, color: string, track: string) => {
  const degrees = (frame % SPIN_FRAMES) * (360 / SPIN_FRAMES)
  return (
    `<svg ${XMLNS} viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">` +
    `<circle cx="8" cy="8" r="5.5" stroke="${track}"/>` +
    `<path d="${RING_ARC}" stroke="${color}" transform="rotate(${degrees} 8 8)"/></svg>`
  )
}

export const SWITCH_SIZE = { width: 26, height: 14 } as const

export const switchSvg = (isOn: boolean, color: string) =>
  `<svg ${XMLNS} viewBox="0 0 26 14">` +
  `<rect width="26" height="14" rx="7" fill="${isOn ? color : OFF_TRACK}"/>` +
  `<circle cx="${isOn ? 19 : 7}" cy="7" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/></svg>`

export type Kind =
  | 'skill'
  | 'agent'
  | 'mcp'
  | 'perm'
  | 'hook'
  | 'rule'
  | 'command'
  | 'memory'
  | 'context'
  | 'checkpoint'
  | 'model'
  | 'background'

export type Toggle = Kind | 'plugin'

export type Status = 'active' | 'running' | 'ok' | 'blocked' | 'denied' | 'error'

export type Activation = {
  kind: Kind
  key: string
  label: string
  detail: string
  source?: string
  meta?: string
  plugin?: string
  status: Status
  count: number
  firstAt: number
  lastAt: number
  runningAgentIds?: string[]
  askedCallId?: string
  agentId?: string
}

export type Layout = 'row' | 'summary'

export type ChipStyle = 'tinted' | 'text'

export type Settings = {
  enabled: boolean
  layout: Layout
  maxChips: number
  chipStyle: ChipStyle
  hotkeys: boolean
  toastOnBlock: boolean
  textSummary: boolean
  shown: Record<Toggle, boolean>
}

export type Overrides = Partial<Omit<Settings, 'maxChips' | 'shown'>> & {
  shown?: Partial<Settings['shown']>
}

export type Filter = Kind | 'all'

export type PaneView = 'detail' | 'activity' | 'settings'

declare module 'claude-code' {
  interface PluginState {
    'session-activity': {
      activations: Activation[]
      muted: string[]
      selected: string | null
      paneView: PaneView
      filter: Filter
      overrides: Overrides | null
    }
  }
}
